description:
Link this chat to the user's existing QuantifyMe account.

    Call this when the user says they already have a QuantifyMe account, or
    asks why their models are missing / where a model went, or wants what they
    deploy here to show up in their own dashboard.

    By default this connector works with NO signup: it mints an anonymous trial
    account per MCP session, so models deployed here belong to that throwaway
    identity rather than to the user's real one. This returns a short-lived URL;
    once the user opens it and approves, every later call that carries the same
    OAuth bearer or the same MCP session acts as their account and deploys land
    in their own model list. A client that opens a new MCP session on every turn
    must link again in that session; every answer's `acting_as` line says which
    identity was used.

    Give the user the `link_url` to open. Nothing else is required from them.
name: link_account
title: Link My QuantifyMe Account
